podcast.title: European Prominence
podcast.body: Electronic dreampop was notably created by European bands such as Spiritualized, Air, and M83, showcasing a distinct regional development. "no es joo discos de espíritu Lies, de R, de M83, de todas estas bandas, así europeas que hacían ese, ese es el electrónica dreampop que era una pasada."

podcast.title: Synthesizer-Driven Sound
podcast.body: This subgenre is described as a captivating sound driven by synthesizers, resulting from the fusion of dreampop with electronic influences. "nos dejaría ese dreampop electrónico desintetizador que era una pasada."

podcast.title: Transcendent Legacy
podcast.body: The sound of electronic dreampop has transcended its origins and continues to influence contemporary music, making its mark on today's soundscape. "a día de hoy eso es un sonido que ha trascendido."
